quests.name: Paying in Barley
quests.offer: The mill keeps its share. The rats appear to have negotiated a share as well. Clear three from Barley Hedge before we lose the seed sacks.
quests.finish: Good. I'll write them a receipt if any of them comes back with a solicitor.

goals.label: Clear the rats from Barley Hedge

quests.name: A Gate on One Hinge
quests.offer: Briar Pasture's gate is hanging by a nail. Get the spare iron pin from the crate by the pasture wall.
quests.finish: My father fixed that gate with a nail. My son says the nail is now listed as part of the farm.

quests.name: A Knife and a Promise
quests.offer: Agna has a knife you can keep. She'll show you how to take a clean hide from a wild boar. The orchard needs leather for the broken gate straps.
quests.finish: Keep it sharp. A blunt knife is exactly like a bad neighbour. It always makes you do the work twice.

quests.name: Leather for the Gate
quests.offer: With the knife on your tool belt, kill and skin two wild boars in Briar Pasture. Bring me the hides. Heda's own pigs stay out of this.
quests.finish: These will do. Heda's youngest says he can mend the gate now. He has said it very loudly in front of witnesses.

goals.label: Skin two wild boars for Agna

quests.name: Supper for the Night Crew
quests.offer: When Nell has taught you to fish, bring Hobb two more perch for the mill hands. Fish from the millpond bank. They have a long watch tonight.
quests.finish: One fish each and the rest is gravy. Good gravy can cover a surprising number of local disputes.

goals.label: Catch two perch in Oatwick Millpond

quests.name: The Notch in the Handle
quests.offer: A knife with a carved sow was tucked behind the old knoll marker. Heda might recognise the carving.
quests.finish: That was Dad's. He always claimed he lost it fighting off a wolf. I expect the wolf was a nap.

quests.name: The Orchard After Dark
quests.offer: There are fresh tracks at Splitrail Wood. Cull four of the wolves before they drive the boars back through the gate.
quests.finish: We can leave the far hedge to the deer now. Tell the cook to start the ovens.

goals.label: Cull the wolves at Splitrail Wood

quests.name: Rent for a Patch of Roof
quests.offer: Reeve Harl has a list of people displaced by the levy. Fetch his tenancy roll from the bench by the watch yard. Bring it to Ledra, who is holding their deposits.
quests.finish: These aren't late rent payments. The book lists a second deposit for the same roof. I'll call a few names today.

goals.label: Find the tenancy roll by the watch yard
Speak to Ledra at the bank

quests.name: A Lantern for the Watch
quests.offer: Pick up tallow near the Bellharbor hearth and give it to Sister Lyra. She's lending lamps to families who search the fields after work.
quests.finish: One lamp costs less than looking for someone in the dark. Please tell the merchants I said that.

goals.label: Bring the tallow to Sister Lyra

quests.name: The Impression
quests.offer: Iren says the relief seal was recut. Ask him to show you the mark left by the old die, then bring that impression to the reeve.
quests.finish: Same stamp, old die. Someone carried this from the old watch into an office with a lock on it.

goals.label: Ask Iren about the old stamp
Take the wax impression from the forge table

quests.name: In Arrears by Morning
quests.offer: The name of one widow was crossed out of both lists. Read the poor-box list at the chapel meeting place and see whom they charged in her place.
quests.finish: They charged her daughter. Good. Now that we know who took her money, we can stop calling it a mistake.

goals.label: Check the list of arrears
goals.note: A second assessment was entered for the same household.

quests.name: The Chapel Keeps the Names
quests.offer: Take the names from Bellharbor to Morrow in Gloamwood. Leave through Lantern Bridge. The chapel stands near the village trail.
quests.finish: Give me the list. There's a name here that was rubbed off three graves.

quests.name: An Unquiet Fence
quests.offer: Widows' Fence still marks the edge of the cemetery. Put down the four walkers and bowmen who now guard the wrong side of it. The wall makes decent cover.
quests.finish: I'll ask the aunties to bring flowers while they can. They'll find something to say about the fence too.

quests.name: Before the Fever
quests.offer: Ditchbell grows on the sheltered chapel bank. I'll teach you to pick it cleanly. Bring three sprigs to the sickroom bench.
quests.finish: Ditchbell for fever, honey for the taste. Some patients claim the honey is the expensive part.

quests.name: Buttons from the Watch
quests.offer: Retrieve three old watch buttons from the bowmen and walkers at Widows' Fence. The wear on the backs can tell me who they were.
quests.finish: This one was sewn on with horsehair. My brother did that whenever he ran out of thread.

goals.label: Recover three watch buttons from the undead

quests.name: The Walk Home
quests.offer: The barrow mourners have to walk home through Blackwood. Thin out the prowlers near Spindlewood before the lanterns go out.
quests.finish: I'll set the last lamp out myself. Walking alone should be a choice.

quests.name: Only Half a Name
quests.offer: Someone folded a torn burial slip and tucked it beside the Bell Barrows. The address on it is Morrow's chapel.
quests.finish: This is the missing half. I can carve her full name again in the morning.

goals.label: Match the slip to the damaged grave
goals.note: The carved half ends in '–ett'. The pinholes match the slip.

quests.name: A Light Left Burning
quests.offer: Someone left lamp oil up by the barrow path as a promise to come back. Fetch the tin and read the initials on the empty marker.
quests.finish: I'll leave a light on that stone. People should have a place to look for a face they miss.

goals.label: Read the marker's initials
goals.note: B. H. The final date was left blank.

quests.name: Ask Where the Wages Went
quests.offer: Take the chapel's copy east through Quarry Cut to the Flintcut shift office. Edda has names that may match our missing families.
quests.finish: The names match the shift list. I'd like to see how the clerk explains that.

quests.name: The Ferry Ledger
quests.offer: Take the chapel's copy across the Sluice Causeway to Reedmire. The landing clerk remembers who paid to cross.
quests.finish: One crossing and two sets of receipts. I'll show you which one we were told to burn.

quests.name: A Pick of Your Own
quests.offer: Iren left a spare mining pick for the shift crew. Fetch it from the Coppervein tool chest. I'll show you where the green copper appears along the cut.
quests.finish: Take the spare from me. The pick in the chest belonged to a man who still wants it back.

quests.name: First Claim on Copper
quests.offer: Mine three lumps of copper from the green veins near the Flintcut track. The tinsmith can mend the shift crew's lamps with them.
quests.finish: That'll do. I don't charge a lamp tax. Try to look surprised.

goals.label: Mine copper from the green veins near Flintcut

quests.name: Something to Stand On
quests.offer: The quarry foreman is still missing the bolts from the hoist. Clear the bowmen and netmen at Hammerfall Stockade so we can reach their stores.
quests.finish: We can drop a line from the top now. Nobody should have to climb back up the wall.

quests.name: Payable in Tokens
quests.offer: Recover four hammered wage tokens from the robbers at Coppervein Spoil. The pay office tried to pass them off as the miners' silver.
quests.finish: Those won't buy an onion in Bellharbor. I'll put four honest coins into the right hands.

goals.label: Recover wage tokens at Coppervein Spoil

quests.name: Look Down Before You Jump
quests.offer: Read the survey peg on Old Quarry Road. If the cut is as wide as the new plan says, they counted a whole shelf of workers' huts as waste rock.
quests.finish: The old peg is honest. I'll show the council where it stands before the contractor moves it too.

goals.label: Inspect the peg above the quarry
goals.note: The original grade ends well short of the workers' huts.

quests.name: Marks under the Shelf
quests.offer: A slate tally dropped near Stonecutters' Way. The initials are scratched over fresh chisel marks.
quests.finish: These are tool rentals. The men paid the same charge for thirty winters. That is quite a business.

quests.name: A Hoist With a Brake
quests.offer: Bring back the rigging pins from the stockade and the brake handle from the lower copper shelf. The ramp crew's first load will be bringing people home.
quests.finish: Pull the red one if it slips. The contractor painted them all red, so we'll have another word with him tomorrow.

goals.label: Find three rigging pins on Hammerfall guards

quests.name: A Toll on Empty Wagons
quests.offer: Take the payroll copy southeast to Sella in Ironstep. Drivers are waiting there to find out whether their wages cover a second toll.
quests.finish: No toll until the drivers hear what was charged. Pull up a bench.

quests.name: Three Feet of Bridge
quests.offer: Find the missing bundle of plank ends by Sluicekeeper's Walk. They were cut to fit a hole at the landing, and that hole currently fits my left boot.
quests.finish: Good. The ferryman can stop claiming the hole is there for drainage.

quests.name: The Gap in the Landing
quests.offer: Clear the drowned and mud scavengers at Drowned Footbridge. Let the lone ones come to you before crossing into the deeper part.
quests.finish: The children can use the landing again. They will find a different place to give their parents a fright.

quests.name: Tied with Blue Twine
quests.offer: The old ferry rings were tied with blue rope. Recover three from the drowned crofters. I want the new ferry to keep the old marks.
quests.finish: It's funny what people remember. My father forgot my birthday, but he knew what colour each ferry line was.

goals.label: Recover ferry rings from the drowned crofters

quests.name: A Basket at the Falls
quests.offer: If you have Fishing 8, catch a pair of silver dace at Bracken Falls Pool. The council meets after work and nobody votes well on an empty stomach.
quests.finish: They'll still argue, but perhaps they'll stop at chewing.

goals.label: Catch two silver dace at Bracken Falls Pool

quests.name: Marks Above the Flood
quests.offer: Read the old flood pole by Heron Oxbow. The oldest cut should show how deep the flooded fields used to get before the new gate went in.
quests.finish: A foot of extra water for the same storm. I'll make the clerk stand waist-deep in it while I explain.

goals.label: Read the flood marks
goals.note: The deepest old cut is still below the new silt line.

quests.name: Paid for in Advance
quests.offer: A ferryman's purse is wedged in the reeds by the sluice. The last coin is tied through a hole in the leather.
quests.finish: My mother tied the coin there so my father would never miss his way home for want of the fare.

quests.name: The Lower Gate
quests.offer: Retrieve the lower sluice key at Drowned Footbridge and read the sluicekeeper's account. The water shares are easier to defend if we can measure them.
quests.finish: Now we can see how much was diverted. I was hoping it was only a muddy ditch worth of money.

goals.label: Recover the parts of the lower gate key
Read the keeper's notes
goals.note: Three extra turns went to the levy orchard during the dry month.

quests.name: Fares to the Tollhouse
quests.offer: Follow the northeast road to Sella in Ironstep. Take the blue ledger so they can see the difference between ferry fare and a toll that was already paid.
quests.finish: We shall ask for one fee, from one traveller, once. Imagine being the first person to think of that.

quests.name: Nails for the Chain
quests.offer: The west gate's chain guide has come loose. Pick up the iron nail bundle near the gate. It's under a tarp a little clear of the patrols.
quests.finish: These will do. He advertised the repair as 'indefinite'. It's a useful word for a man who never turns up.

quests.name: Bowmen Above the Road
quests.offer: Four of the old road pickets have been holding travellers between the bends. Clear the high toll and keep a stone between you and the archers.
quests.finish: The next wagon has children aboard. I'll tell the driver the bows are gone.

goals.label: Clear pickets at the High Toll

quests.name: Reckoned by the Axle
quests.offer: Recover four levy tags from Broken Toll. The stamp should show whether they charged for wagons, people, or both.
quests.finish: By the axle going uphill and by the head coming down. Some of them must have paid twice in the same breath.

goals.label: Recover levy tags from Broken Toll raiders

quests.name: Four Short, One Long
quests.offer: Climb the path to Signalman's Shelf and read how the old bell code worked. Then recover the missing striker tucked under the marker.
quests.finish: Four short for fog, one long for danger. When it was my father's shift, they rang both on payday.

goals.label: Read the old bell code
goals.note: Four short rings mark fog. One long ring means the road is closed.

quests.name: Solid Through the Middle
quests.offer: The watch needs two copper bars for a replacement bush. Smelt them at our forge if you know Smithing. A trader's bars will fit too.
quests.finish: Good copper. The last bush came with an illustrated warranty and went green in the first rain.

goals.label: Smelt or source two copper bars

quests.name: The Wrong End of the Hoist
quests.offer: Break the High Toll's escort and take its orders. The runner and the bows hold the approaches. Wait for a gap instead of charging both ways at once.
quests.finish: The orders say to lower the gate if the drivers complain. It fails to say who pays for the gate.

goals.label: Recover three pieces of the toll orders

quests.name: The Old Route Badge
quests.offer: A road badge is pinned inside a rotten satchel at Webbed Deep. The worn inscription gives Sella's initials.
quests.finish: I lost that before my first night on the road. It spent longer wearing a uniform than I did.

quests.name: Through Ironstep Gate
quests.offer: Follow the ridge road through Ironstep Gate to Ashcourt. Take the orders to the keeper who tends the knight graves.
quests.finish: The toll was levied in our order's name. I would like a word with the man who found our seal.

quests.name: Down the Cliff Stair
quests.offer: Take the Cliff Stair south to Tidemark. Tell the dock keeper which wagons the levy sent down into the wrecking cove.
quests.finish: So it was the gate that sent them down here. I can put people to work on the beach today.

quests.name: Marching without a Bell
quests.offer: The Unlit Procession has started marching past the graves. Lay four of its guards to rest before they reach the chapel. Fall back from the glow under their feet.
quests.finish: They stood with people once. I hope somebody tells that part of the story.

goals.label: Lay the Procession's guards to rest

quests.name: The Bees Don't Owe Tithes
quests.offer: Fetch the votive wax stored at Veilwood Hollow. The beekeeper left it above the path when the wolves came out.
quests.finish: He wanted the brightest candles for the poorest names. That was all he ever asked.

quests.name: A Red Stain Comes Out
quests.offer: Bring three sprigs of bloodroot for the stone wash. If you already grow it in Reedmire, that will do. Otherwise search the higher bank behind the chapel.
quests.finish: The whole stone will be red for a day. Then we'll scrape off the chalk somebody sold us as a fake inscription.

quests.name: The Names on the Pins
quests.offer: Take back the oath pins from the Procession. The old wardens carved their home names along the inside edge, so we should be able to bury them properly.
quests.finish: A baker, a weaver, two people from the same family. That's more than the old register gave them.

quests.name: Keep Off the Ribbons
quests.offer: The prowlers behind Veilwood Hollow have been pulling grave ribbons down. Thin the pack so the weavers can rehang them.
quests.finish: There will be white ribbons before morning. We haven't had a white road in years.

quests.name: With Their Own Hands
quests.offer: Read the names carved on Vigil Crypt's founding stone. Check the broken shield set against it for the older maker's stamp.
quests.finish: Not one of the seven founders signed as a lord. I will have that put into the new record at the top.

goals.label: Read the founders' names
goals.note: The inscription lists seven trades beside seven names.

quests.name: Ink on the Back
quests.offer: You found a charcoal rubbing hidden by the crypt approach. Its reverse shows a burial payment in a different hand.
quests.finish: Thank you. We can show historians what actually happened before the bark dries on their fine new ink.

quests.name: The Living Need a Road Too
quests.offer: Take the lamplighters' timber wedge to the hollow and clear the path for the stonemasons. The procession keeps following anyone who carries a light.
quests.finish: The stonemasons can work in daylight now. A person can get a surprising amount done before the bells if the dead give them peace.

goals.label: Clear the path at Veilwood Hollow

quests.name: A Place by the Road
quests.offer: Find the bundle of clean grave ribbons at the chapel and carry them to the marker outside the village. The new graves are for the people we're still waiting for.
quests.finish: We'll hang a ribbon for each person until a family comes back to take it down.

goals.label: Find the marker for missing families
goals.note: Each hanging ribbon marks someone whose family has yet to find them.

quests.name: Copies for Redgate
quests.offer: Take a copy to Pell's table in Redgate. The road runs southeast from Ashcourt. Let him keep the one with the witness's signature.
quests.finish: I'll give it a file and an entry in both books, so I cannot accidentally lose it even if asked.

quests.name: Names at the Caravan Stop
quests.offer: Take the copy to the caravan keeper at Redwash. Pass through Redgate, then follow the southern road. He may know which of our people left the downs and never came home.
quests.finish: Some of these names are in my missing wagons list. Let's find the wagons before we start carving more stones.

hubs.story: The lights that called ships in

quests.name: Lowwater Pickers
quests.offer: The first salvage crew is pulling people out of the wreck. Clear the wreck pickers at Lowwater Strand before they take the stretchers for timber.
quests.finish: All the living are up on the quay now. We'll try to keep it that way.

goals.label: Clear the wreck pickers on Lowwater Strand

quests.name: Cargo That Can Talk
quests.offer: Three cargo tallies were taken by the wreck pickers. Bring them back. They list the people working passage, who aren't on the passenger roll.
quests.finish: There are seven more families to write to. I'd rather be writing to people than closing the count.

goals.label: Recover tallies from the wreck pickers

quests.name: Read the False Light
quests.offer: Read the wick marks on the wreckers' spare lantern. It stands just uphill from the signal bluff. Three short flashes are meant to call in a pilot.
quests.finish: Their long flash came from uneven oil. There should never have been a long flash at all.

goals.label: Inspect the lantern and its wick marks
goals.note: Three cuts at the same height. A fault in the shutter added a fourth.

quests.name: A Line in the Night
quests.offer: Bring back the signal crew's new guide ropes. They used our own rope to moor the fake pilot boats.
quests.finish: This is quay rope. I know because it came out of my pay until the charges were settled.

goals.label: Recover guide ropes from the signal crew

quests.name: The Second Beacon
quests.offer: Defeat five of the crew guarding the second beacon. Start at the edge. The archers can make the bluff a bad place to stand still.
quests.finish: The light is ours again. It will stay dark until the real pilot is on duty.

quests.name: The Bell on Dry Ground
quests.offer: Find the bell the wreckers dragged up from the third hull. Return it with one of the signal flags. The family can give the ship a proper farewell.
quests.finish: The family can decide what goes home and what goes into the sea with her.

quests.name: Up the Salt Road
quests.offer: Follow the road inland to the Redwash caravan stop. Give them the list of crates lost to the wreckers. Cart drivers have been paid in the same goods.
quests.finish: That explains why the men arriving from the coast have paid tax twice and still don't own their coats.

hubs.story: A capital with a short memory

quests.name: Bread before Petitions
quests.offer: Before I can hear another petition, bring a loaf to Ysolde and speak to her about the kitchen. The Redgate inn sells it. The people queuing outside are here for more than paper.
quests.finish: There are nineteen names on the petition. Twenty if you count the little girl who signed with a drawing of a dog.

goals.label: Bring a loaf of trail bread
Speak to Ysolde about the kitchen

quests.name: One Stamp Short
quests.offer: A brass die is locked away by the refinery court. Take the storage ticket, then ask Sabeth who was authorised to use it.
quests.finish: Two names are on the ticket and only one is still alive. That's useful. The dead man is very hard to bribe.

goals.label: Pick up the die's storage ticket
Ask Sabeth who signed out the die

quests.name: Return of the Handcart
quests.offer: A worker's handcart was left near the east gate. Bring the permit back to the bank clerk's bench and have the loan struck off the record.
quests.finish: He owed more for parking it than he did for buying it. I'll put that in the margin for anyone keeping score.

goals.label: Ask Corvin to witness the return

quests.name: Behind the Amendments
quests.offer: Read the list of old charters next to the market and check which of the six original relief clauses is still being honoured.
quests.finish: One out of six. I'll write the other five in bigger letters when I copy them down.

goals.label: Read the amendments on the charter list
goals.note: Only the authority to levy a fee was kept unchanged.

quests.name: An Account from the Furnace
quests.offer: Take the charter copy east to the workers at Cinder March. They should know what the furnace was meant to be producing before they were made to burn the relief stores.
quests.finish: Good thing you came out in person. There aren't many people left here who can ask Redgate for a straight answer.

quests.name: The Dry Camps
quests.offer: Clear the pickets outside the Siltjack Supply Loop. Keep to the outer path so the bowmen at the stacked crates stay out of reach until you are ready.
quests.finish: The mules can make it past the fork. I'd shake your hand if I could get them to stand still.

quests.name: The Wheel That Came Back
quests.offer: Recover the spare wheel pin by Siltjack Camp. Someone put it through the flap of a sack to stop the wind getting in.
quests.finish: That stops the wheel getting off. Turned out we needed that more.

quests.name: Three Sacks to a Family
quests.offer: Bring back the Siltjacks' stolen ration seals and compare them with the stamped crate. The salt shed is turning away families whose wares were taken.
quests.finish: A seal can open the storehouse, but a sack still has to arrive inside it. I'll have people count both.

goals.label: Recover ration seals from the Siltjacks
Inspect the ration crate's marks
goals.note: The same batch stamp was used for two deliveries.

quests.name: Wood on a Dry Road
quests.offer: Bring three ash logs to replace the spare cart braces. You can cut the short stand above Redwash or buy logs from a woodcutter.
quests.finish: Good. We can cut this to fit. The quartermaster's instructions advised making the cart wider instead.

quests.name: The List under the Saddle
quests.offer: Drive the quartermaster's guard off the supply loop and take the list of drivers who still have a wagon missing.
quests.finish: Three came forward this week. I'll see the other four get the same offer when they get in.

quests.name: A Place on the Wagon
quests.offer: A passenger token sits tucked behind a camp post. The holder had a paid seat to Redgate.
quests.finish: There's a vacancy on our next wagon. I'll ask if he's still willing to use it.

quests.name: Where the Relief Timber Went
quests.offer: Carry the Siltjack bill up the eastern road to Cinder March. The missing timber was signed out to a furnace warden.
quests.finish: A timber load on my signature. I'll tell you where I was while somebody borrowed it.

hubs.story: The workers who kept the fire

quests.name: Cold Water for Hot Hands
quests.offer: Take clean canisters from the relief camp. Bring them to the boiler lane before the workers come off shift. There's a low shelf by the lane you can reach from the yard.
quests.finish: There might not be another water break. Nobody will be too proud to take a drink, I hope.

goals.label: Find the workers' water shelf
goals.note: The workers left a cold ladle so the next shift could drink.

quests.name: Leave the Boiler Lane Clear
quests.offer: Clear four of the bandits at Boiler Run. Their overseer sleeps at the far shelf. You can reach the workers without waking him if you're careful.
quests.finish: That room was never built for fighting. It'll be nice to see someone use it as a road again.

quests.name: Wedges for the Door
quests.offer: Retrieve four iron wedges from the ogres near the fuel yard. They keep taking them out from under the store doors and using them as dice.
quests.finish: These have one dot and they're all bent. Mind you, that explains how they kept winning.

goals.label: Recover wedges from the fuel-yard ogres

quests.name: Fourteen Men to a Shift
quests.offer: Read the brass tally under the clock, then talk to the relay keeper. Their schedule only shows thirteen times people clocked out.
quests.finish: The fourteenth had a family. I will put his name in ink and look the next inspector in the eye.

goals.label: Read the tally under the lane clock
goals.note: Fourteen names entered. The last space for clocking out was left empty.

quests.name: Thick Enough to Last
quests.offer: The stores need two copper bars for pressure-safe valve seats. A smith at the Cinder forge can smelt them, or trade for them before coming in.
quests.finish: Copper. Good. The overseer always sent us painted lead and asked why the valves leaked.

goals.label: Supply two copper bars for the valves

quests.name: Proof in the Clinker
quests.offer: Ogres are digging out burnt relief stamps from the coal tips. Bring back four pieces with the stamped ends intact.
quests.finish: So they burned the relief stock while people asked for firewood. Keep one marked piece for the inquiry.

goals.label: Recover charred relief stamps from the ogres

quests.name: Quiet the Cold Boilers
quests.offer: The dead shift is still holding the cold boilers. Break up the pressure crew before trying to reach the emergency valves. The grave-caller stays near the rear.
quests.finish: I heard all those men complain about working late. They deserved to stop when the bell went.

goals.label: Lay the boiler crew to rest

quests.name: Turn Off the Feed
quests.offer: Find the handwheel behind the guard and read the valve plate. The old copper feed needs to be closed before the other furnaces can come down safely.
quests.finish: Half a turn. That's all the night supervisor would have had to do before he left.

goals.label: Read the valve instructions
goals.note: In an emergency, close the copper feed first.

quests.name: Last Call at the Relay
quests.offer: Get the relay keeper four brass shift tabs. The dead crew still wears them and the names will match those missing from the roll.
quests.finish: Now I can tell their families who was here, and who left carrying a perfectly clean coat.

goals.label: Recover the cold boiler crew's shift tabs

quests.name: The Relief Road Opens
quests.offer: The relief road can carry supplies again. Read the posted loads and help clear the remaining crew from the upper boilers so Whitehorn's flour can go through.
quests.finish: Four sacks for each family. No special rate for those who can afford to pay.

goals.label: Read the reopened road's cargo list
goals.note: Flour for Whitehorn. Spare canvas for Saltglass. The space for a toll has been crossed out.

quests.name: Flour for Whitehorn
quests.offer: Follow the Snowline Gate up to Whitehorn. Tell the keeper the flour wagons are ready as soon as she can get the road marked.
quests.finish: Good. I have men and women ready to dig. Now there is something worth digging for.

quests.name: A Well That Anybody Can Use
quests.offer: Follow the southern track to Saltglass and give the wellkeeper the charter. A person should be able to drink without promising their cart.
quests.finish: I'll post this where the first bucket comes up. People can read it while they wait.

quests.name: The Shelter Line
quests.offer: Take the spare shelter braces to the top of Goat Stair. Find the last route post before the windbreak and read the notch put there by the winter crews.
quests.finish: We'll add another post at the bend. I'd rather the children have one more thing to see through snow.

goals.label: Read the route post
goals.note: The carved hook points towards the nearest shelter.

quests.name: A Fire for the Late Watch
quests.offer: Break up the oath-keepers at Snowblind Watch. They haven't left a straight way to the braziers in days.
quests.finish: The next watch can go outside with a lamp instead of a prayer.

quests.name: A Name in the Last Cairn
quests.offer: An old winter badge has fallen out of a cairn at the summit. Its initials match the lower watch clerk's records.
quests.finish: My uncle was meant to come back in spring. His name can go on the lower shelf where we can reach it.

quests.name: Over the Salt Stair
quests.offer: Take the winter account down the Salt Stair. The wellkeeper has had the same names coming up from the desert without their provisions.
quests.finish: We have been paying the same charge in heat as you've been paying in snow.

quests.name: First Bucket at Dawn
quests.offer: Get the guards off the Bucket Road. Families are waiting to draw water from the low well. The captain's quarry is deeper in the sand, away from the first patrols.
quests.finish: The first bucket goes to the people who have been standing in line since before dawn.

quests.name: Salt Fish for the Road
quests.offer: If you have Fishing 32, catch two mullet at Cutlass Cove. They salt well, and the mule crews can carry them to the wells without a fire.
quests.finish: Good choice. Hungry people don't need a ceremonial meal. They'll be pleased to eat one they can carry.

goals.label: Catch two mullet at Cutlass Cove

quests.name: A Sail without a Boat
quests.offer: A ship's strip of sailcloth is tied to a ridge above Smuggler's Cut. The faded letter is the wellkeeper's family mark.
quests.finish: They signalled my mother with a piece like that. If the ship still has a name, we can put it on the well.

quests.name: Across to Starfall
quests.offer: Take the ferry from Saltglass to Starfall. Give the keeper the witness seal. It is the copy the merchants can't claim fell overboard.
quests.finish: Put it on the dry table, please. This island knows what happened to the last copy somebody threw out a window.

hubs.story: The families waiting at the landing

quests.name: Ghostlight at the Landing
quests.offer: Lay five drowned crew to rest on Ghostlight Shore. The lights are leading returning boats into the rocks again.
quests.finish: We can sail in at low tide with the windows open now. I missed that more than I expected.

goals.label: Clear the false signals on Ghostlight Shore

quests.name: Papers for the Living
quests.offer: Recover four fare papers from the drowned signal crew. Passes still marked valid belong to people we might be able to help leave.
quests.finish: I'll write in what they were promised. It should be the sort of thing a person can show at a dock.

goals.label: Recover fare papers on Ghostlight Shore

quests.name: The Last Witness
quests.offer: Take the ferry back to Saltglass, then the north road to the Crown of Ash. Sera needs our landing deed before the levy puts its last stamp on the decree.
quests.finish: We've got a living witness at last. I will ask the court to remember what one looks like.

quests.name: Under the Broken Standard
quests.offer: The last guards still hold formation at the Broken Standard. Clear them away so the witnesses can come up the old road in daylight.
quests.finish: I'll send for the witnesses. There is a place for them to sit now.

quests.name: The Names in the Margin
quests.offer: Find the pay packet by the signal fire and read the new witness roll. The names of the workers killed in the taking of the crown should go on the same page as the money.
quests.finish: The money would have had a place in the record either way. Thank you for making room for everything else.

goals.label: Read the new witness roll
goals.note: The clerks were given a whole page to list the relatives of each dead worker.

fields.name: Barley Hedge
fields.note: Scattered vermin beside the barley. A safe first hunt.

fields.name: Widows' Fence
fields.note: Loose bone archers cover the corners of a broken fence.

fields.name: Hammerfall Stockade
fields.note: Shielded foreman and a short line of quarry bowmen. Pull from the ramp.

fields.name: Drowned Footbridge
fields.note: Mud runners roam separately. A caster and two drowned watch the landing.

fields.name: The High Toll
fields.note: Road pickets surround the levy captain. Ranged cover and close escorts guard the hoist.

fields.name: The Unlit Procession
fields.note: The old guard marches with a grave-caller and its attendants. Expect overlapping casts.

fields.name: Lowwater Strand
fields.note: Scavengers and wreck pickers are spread along the strand, with stronger crews inland.

fields.name: Wreckers' Signal Bluff
fields.note: The beacon crew fights in pairs. The boatswain signals from the rear.

fields.name: The Siltjack Supply Loop
fields.note: Two pickets patrol the outside. The quartermaster has bows covering the stores.

fields.name: Boiler Run
fields.note: Scattered workers turned bandits, with an ogre overseer far off the main lane.

fields.name: The Cold Boilers
fields.note: Ash spirits and a furnace keeper guard the old stop valves. Bring room for the sweeps.

fields.name: Snowblind Watch
fields.note: Wolves outside the braziers, oath-keepers and ice archers within.

fields.name: The Bucket Road
fields.note: Well guards make small, tight groups, with open sand between patrols.

fields.name: Ghostlight Shore
fields.note: Drowned crews bunch around the signal lamps. Spectral marksmen hold the outer beach.

fields.name: The Broken Standard
fields.note: Veteran guards still keep formation around an abandoned signal fire.
